verdict.rationale: Exa documents a per-query search type, but the evidence describes those types only as latency-quality profiles (instant/Lite, Auto, Deep, deep-reasoning). Nothing in the pack shows keyword, neural, or hybrid retrieval modes. A related but different switch is an adjacent control and earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose between keyword, neural, or hybrid retrieval modes per query
